Don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant,” says Yahweh; “for I am with you; for I will make a full end of all the nations…
You will arise and have mercy on Zion; for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak, whose stump remains…
It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of…
I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from Yahweh.”
This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.
Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up…
They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell…

Behold, the eyes of the Lord Yahweh are on the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the surface of the earth…
“For, behold, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations, as grain is sifted in a sieve…

They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

translations.web: There is hope for your latter end,” says Yahweh. “Your children will come again to their own territory.
translations.bsb: So there is hope for your future, declares the LORD, and your children will return to their own land.
translations.kjv: And there is hope in thine end, saith the LORD, that thy children shall come again to their own border.
translations.asv: And there is hope for thy latter end, saith Jehovah; and thy children shall come again to their own border.
